summary: Polish uses być broadly and overtly, while existential/presentational and negative-existential patterns add case and construction-specific behavior.

semantic_map.SEM.CLASSIFICATION_ROLE: być + predicate noun, often instrumental for class/role predication
semantic_map.SEM.CURRENT_STATE: być + state predicate; lexical state predicates also occur
semantic_map.SEM.RESULTANT_STATE: być/zostać + result-state predicate depending state vs change
semantic_map.SEM.EVENT_LOCATION: być/odbywać się + locative expression by event construction
semantic_map.SEM.EXISTENCE_PRESENCE: być / istnieć / znajdować się according to presentational vs lexical existence
semantic_map.SEM.ABSENCE_NONEXISTENCE: nie ma + genitive is a central negative existential; nie istnieje for lexical nonexistence
semantic_map.SEM.MATERIAL_COMPOSITION: być zrobionym z / być z + material
semantic_map.SEM.POSSESSION_AS_EXISTENCE: ordinary possession uses mieć; existential possession is not the default general rule
